nominees.title: The Rings of Saturn
nominees.author: W. G. Sebald
nominees.pitch: A walk along the Suffolk coast that keeps falling through the floor into history. Slow, and then suddenly enormous.

nominees.title: Cold Enough for Snow
nominees.author: Jessica Au
nominees.pitch: A mother and daughter in Tokyo, saying almost nothing. Short enough that even Tom will finish it.

nominees.title: Small Things Like These
nominees.author: Claire Keegan
nominees.pitch: A coal merchant in 1985 Ireland notices something he could choose not to notice. Perfect for December weather in April.

nominees.title: The Vegetarian
nominees.author: Han Kang
nominees.pitch: A woman stops eating meat and the world around her comes apart. We will not agree about it, which is the point.

current.title: Piranesi
current.author: Susanna Clarke
current.blurb: A man lives alone in a house of endless halls and tidal seas, keeping careful notes on the statues and the birds. It is a puzzle, but the pleasure of it is the voice — patient, decent, entirely unbothered by the fact that his world makes no sense. Bring your theories; we will disagree warmly.
questions: Does the House work better as a place or as a metaphor — and does it matter?
Piranesi is kind almost to a fault. Is that innocence, or damage?
Where did the ending leave you: relieved, or a bit bereft?

shelf.title: Klara and the Sun
shelf.author: Kazuo Ishiguro
shelf.notes: Priya’s, Barnsbury. Split the room — half moved by the ending, half unconvinced Klara was ever really looking.

shelf.title: Cold Enough for Snow
shelf.author: Jessica Au
shelf.notes: The Alma, back room. Short enough that everyone finished it.

shelf.title: A Christmas Memory
shelf.author: Truman Capote
shelf.notes: Jonah’s, Angel. Christmas cheese; read the last pages aloud.

shelf.title: The Overstory
shelf.author: Richard Powers
shelf.notes: Ruth’s, Canonbury. Long. Two people skipped to the trees.

shelf.title: Dept. of Speculation
shelf.author: Jenny Offill
shelf.notes: Argued about whether the fragments earn their whiteness. They do.

shelf.title: Concrete: A Life
shelf.author: Rachel Adler
shelf.notes: Nobody’s favourite, but a good night.

shelf.title: The Remains of the Day
shelf.author: Kazuo Ishiguro
shelf.notes: The high point of the year so far — unanimous.

shelf.title: H is for Hawk
shelf.author: Helen Macdonald
shelf.notes: Summer outing; read half of it in the park.

events.title: March meeting — Piranesi
events.note: Soup, because it is still March. Bring a passage you marked and one thing that annoyed you.

events.title: Bookshop crawl
events.note: Four shops, one pub, a strict twenty-pound ceiling that nobody observes.

events.title: April meeting — winner of the vote
events.note: Whichever of the four nominees takes it. Marek has promised the good coffee.
